requirements.label: Course explicitly domestic-only
cells: Australia: "Available to: Domestic students only" (e.g. Excelsia Grad Cert in Christian Leadership)
Skip at scrape time with reason "domestic-only". Never stage for review.

requirements.label: Domestic fee shown alongside international fee
cells: Page lists "Domestic: A$9,100 / International: A$24,000"
Do NOT reject. Store the international fee only.

requirements.label: No visa registration code on page
cells: Australian course with no CRICOS code listed
Mark "eligibility unverified" and check the official CRICOS register. Reject only if the register confirms it isn't listed.

requirements.label: Home-fee-only course
cells: UK: degree apprenticeships or courses open to "home students only"
Skip as not internationally eligible.

requirements.label: Online-only delivery
cells: Course delivered 100% online
Flag: usually not eligible for a student visa. Store delivery mode and mark for review.

requirements.label: Part-time only
cells: UK and Australian student visas generally need full-time study
Flag as "not visa-eligible" unless a full-time option exists.

requirements.label: Eligibility stated on a separate international page
cells: Course page silent; "International students" page lists eligible courses
Follow the link and use the international page as evidence.

requirements.label: Eligibility differs by campus
cells: Course runs on two campuses but only one is CRICOS-registered
Create one record per eligible campus. Skip the ineligible campus.

requirements.label: EU/EEA-only course or fee
cells: Ireland or Netherlands course open only to EU applicants, or EU fee shown
Store the non-EU fee. Skip if non-EU students can't apply.

requirements.label: Visa-ready institution check
cells: US school must be SEVP-certified to issue I-20s; Canada needs a DLI number
Store the code if shown. Mark "unverified" if missing.

requirements.label: Annual fee
cells: UK: "International fee: £22,500 per year"
Store as annual. Calculate full course = annual × duration.

requirements.label: Full course fee
cells: Australia: "A$44,600 full course"
Store as full course. Calculate annual equivalent.

requirements.label: Per credit or per unit fee
cells: US: "$1,450 per credit hour"; Australia: "A$3,800 per 10-credit-point unit"
Store the rate. Calculate the annual fee only if the standard full-time load is stated. Otherwise mark "estimate".

requirements.label: Per semester or per term fee
cells: Canada or Malaysia: fee per semester or term
Convert to annual using the number of terms per year stated on the page.

requirements.label: Fee for a future year
cells: "2027 indicative fees" shown in late 2026
Store the year the fee applies to. Prefer the fee for the next intake.

requirements.label: Fee is "indicative" or "subject to change"
cells: Common on Australian and UK pages
Store with an "indicative" flag. Don't treat it as final.

requirements.label: Fee only in a PDF schedule
cells: Separate "International fee schedule 2027" PDF
Read the PDF and match the course by name and code.

requirements.label: Scholarship mixed into fee
cells: "A$30,000 (A$24,000 after 20% scholarship)"
Store the gross fee. Store the scholarship separately.

requirements.label: US in-state vs out-of-state vs international
cells: Public US universities list three rates
Store the international (or out-of-state if no separate international rate) fee only.

requirements.label: Tuition-free but fees apply
cells: Germany: no tuition at most public universities, but a semester contribution applies; some states charge non-EU students
Store tuition = 0 and the semester fee separately. Check the state's non-EU tuition rule.

requirements.label: Wrong currency assumed
cells: Malaysian page in MYR, Irish page in EUR
Always store the currency code. Never convert without a stated rate and date.

requirements.label: Fee missing from course page
cells: Fee sits on a central "fees" page
Search the site's fee page. If still missing, mark "fee unverified".

requirements.label: Intake in a details block
cells: Excelsia: "Intake: February and July"
Parse into [Feb, Jul]. This is the field the current extractor missed.

requirements.label: Intake named by season or semester
cells: US "Fall / Spring"; Germany "Winter semester / Summer semester"
Map to months (Fall = Aug/Sep, Spring = Jan; Winter = Oct, Summer = Apr). Keep the original wording too.

requirements.label: Intake named by term
cells: Australia "Trimester 1, 2, 3"; Canada "Fall, Winter, Summer"
Map to months using the university's own academic calendar.

requirements.label: Intake differs for international students
cells: "Domestic: Feb, Jul, Nov. International: Feb, Jul only"
Store the international intakes only.

requirements.label: Intake differs by campus
cells: Sydney campus Feb/Jul, Melbourne campus Feb only
Store intakes per campus record.

requirements.label: Intake closed or full
cells: "Applications for July 2027 are closed"
Store the intake with status "closed". Don't delete it.

requirements.label: Duration with options
cells: "1.5 years full-time / 3 years part-time"
Store the full-time duration as the main value.

requirements.label: Duration depends on prior study
cells: "1–2 years depending on your background"
Store the range (min, max). Note the condition.

requirements.label: Duration in credits only
cells: "240 credit points" or "120 ECTS"
Convert only if the page states the full-time load. Otherwise mark "unverified".

requirements.label: Course includes work placement or co-op
cells: Canada co-op adds a term; UK "with placement year" adds 1 year
Store as a separate variant with its own duration.

requirements.label: IELTS with band minimum
cells: "IELTS 6.5 with no band less than 6.0"
Store overall = 6.5, minimum band = 6.0.

requirements.label: Band-specific minimums
cells: "IELTS 7.0, writing 7.0, other bands 6.5"
Store per-band values, not just the lowest.

requirements.label: Requirement on a faculty or band page
cells: Course says "English Band B"; a separate page defines Band B scores
Follow the link and resolve Band B to actual scores.

requirements.label: Multiple tests accepted
cells: IELTS, TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Cambridge, Duolingo
Store each accepted test and score. Don't assume a test is accepted if it isn't listed.

requirements.label: Test variant required
cells: UK may require "IELTS for UKVI" for some courses
Store the variant. Flag if it differs from standard IELTS Academic.

requirements.label: Course page and international page disagree
cells: Course page says IELTS 6.5; English requirements page says 7.0
Flag as a conflict for review. Don't pick one silently.

requirements.label: Generic site-wide requirement only
cells: "All postgraduate courses: IELTS 6.5"
Use it, but mark source as "general, not course-specific".

requirements.label: Academic requirement by country
cells: UK and Australian sites list entry rules per country (e.g. Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka)
Store the requirement for SIC's source markets. Note which country page it came from.

requirements.label: Academic requirement too vague
cells: "A recognised bachelor's degree or equivalent"
Store as-is. Mark "academic requirement unverified" (as in the Master of Counselling row).

requirements.label: Prerequisites or portfolio
cells: Specific subjects, work experience, interview or portfolio required
Store as additional requirements, separate from English and academic.

requirements.label: Same course already in database
cells: Re-scrape of Master of Counselling
Update the existing record. Never create a duplicate.

requirements.label: Similar names, different courses
cells: "Master of IT" vs "Master of IT (Advanced)"
Treat as separate courses. Match on course code or CRICOS code, not name alone.

requirements.label: Course with specialisations
cells: MBA with majors in Finance, Marketing, HR
One course record with majors listed, unless each major has its own code.

requirements.label: Double or combined degree
cells: "Bachelor of Commerce / Bachelor of Laws"
Store as its own course. Don't merge into either single degree.

requirements.label: Honours or placement variant
cells: UK "BSc Computing" vs "BSc Computing with Placement Year"
Separate records with separate duration and fee.

requirements.label: Pathway or packaged offer
cells: Diploma + Bachelor package; foundation programme
Store the pathway as a separate course and link it to the destination degree.

requirements.label: Course discontinued
cells: "No longer taking new enrolments" or page removed (404)
Mark existing record "discontinued". Don't delete; flag published records for review.

requirements.label: Course renamed
cells: Old URL redirects to a new course name
Update the name, keep history, and note the redirect.

requirements.label: Same course at multiple campuses
cells: Sydney and Melbourne with different fees or intakes
One record per campus when fees, intakes or eligibility differ.

requirements.label: Course offered via partner provider
cells: Delivered by a private college on behalf of a university
Store both the awarding university and the delivering provider.

requirements.label: Content loaded by JavaScript
cells: Fees or intakes appear only after the page script runs, or after clicking a "International" toggle
Use a headless browser. Click the international toggle before reading.

requirements.label: Content in tabs or accordions
cells: "Entry requirements" hidden in a collapsed section
Expand all sections, or read the full page HTML.

requirements.label: Data only in PDF
cells: Course guide, fee schedule or brochure PDF
Download and parse the PDF. Record the PDF URL and page as evidence.

requirements.label: Bot protection or rate limiting
cells: Cloudflare challenge, 403 or 429 errors
Slow down and retry later. Never bypass a CAPTCHA. Mark "source unavailable" and report it.

requirements.label: Pagination or filters on course list
cells: Course finder shows 20 per page or uses infinite scroll
Follow all pages until the full list is collected. Report the total count.

requirements.label: Page in another language
cells: Germany, Netherlands, Japan or Malaysia pages partly in local language
Prefer the official English version. If none, translate and keep the original snippet as evidence.

requirements.label: Broken link or 404
cells: Course URL no longer works
Search the site for the course. If not found, mark "possibly discontinued".

requirements.label: Redirect to generic page
cells: Course URL redirects to the faculty homepage
Treat as not found. Don't extract data from the generic page.

requirements.label: Navigation and form noise
cells: Menus, enquiry forms and dropdown course lists (as in the Excelsia excerpts)
Extract from the main content area only. Trim evidence to the relevant lines.

requirements.label: Two sources conflict
cells: Course page says Feb/Jul; PDF guide says Feb only
Prefer the most recent official source. Flag the conflict with both snippets.

requirements.label: Stale data
cells: Page last updated in 2024; fees for 2025 shown
Store the year. Flag as possibly out of date.

requirements.label: Same page fetched repeatedly
cells: Agent re-reads the same URL on every chat message
Cache pages for the session. Re-fetch only when asked or when the cache is old.

requirements.label: "Master of Counselling add intake Feb and July"
cells: Edit the intake field on the existing row. No page fetch needed if the user gives the value. No new course record.

requirements.label: "Is this course removed?"
cells: Answer from the database instantly: row status, when and by whom it was excluded. No web fetch.

requirements.label: "We don't need domestic-only courses"
cells: Save as a standing rule. Apply it now to all pending rows and report what was excluded.

requirements.label: "Remove this course and check others as well"
cells: Exclude the named course, check every pending row in the batch, report the full list.

requirements.label: "Fix the IELTS for all Excelsia courses"
cells: Check each course's official page, update where evidence is clear, list conflicts for review.

requirements.label: "Why is this course flagged?"
cells: Explain the flag in one or two lines with the evidence.

requirements.label: "Undo that"
cells: Reverse the last change from the audit log and confirm.

requirements.label: "Re-scrape this course"
cells: Fetch the latest page, show what changed (old vs new), apply clear changes to the pending row.

requirements.label: "Approve all verified courses"
cells: Published-record change: list the courses and ask for confirmation first.

requirements.label: "Which courses have no intake?"
cells: Database query only. Return the list with row links.

requirements.label: "Add University of X courses"
cells: Start a new scrape job for that provider, apply all standing rules, report counts when done.

requirements.label: "Show me what changed today"
cells: Return today's audit log: row, field, old value, new value, who made the change.

requirements.label: Canada
cells: Designated Learning Institution (DLI) number

requirements.label: New Zealand
cells: Institution signed up to the international student Code of Practice

NZD

requirements.label: Ireland

requirements.label: Germany
cells: Recognised public or private institution
Winter (Oct), Summer (Apr)
Per semester
EUR

requirements.label: Netherlands
cells: Institution with recognised sponsor status
Sep (some Feb)
Annual

requirements.label: Malaysia
cells: Approval for international students via EMGS
Several per year, varies by university
Per semester or full programme
MYR
Intakes vary widely by institution

requirements.label: International fee
cells: International, Overseas, Non-UK, Non-EU, International student fee, Full-fee paying (international), Tuition fee (international), Annual tuition, Course fee, CRICOS fee
Surrey uses "Overseas fees"; UK often "Overseas" or "International"; Ireland "Non-EU"

requirements.label: Domestic fee (to ignore)
cells: UK fees, Home fees, Home/EU, Domestic, CSP, Commonwealth supported, FEE-HELP, In-state, Resident, EU fee
Must never be stored as the international fee

requirements.label: Intake
cells: Intake, Start date, Starting dates, Course starting dates, Commencement, Entry points, Study periods, Teaching periods, Terms, Semester start, Entry month
UWS uses "Course starting dates"; Surrey "Start date September 2027"

requirements.label: Duration
cells: Duration, Course length, Length of study, Study mode, Full time X years, Duration & study mode, Time to complete, Programme length
UWS "Duration & study mode"; Surrey "Full time 3 years"

requirements.label: English
cells: English language requirements, IELTS, Language requirements, English proficiency, ELP, English test scores, English band
Often on a separate linked page

requirements.label: Academic entry
cells: Entry requirements, Typical offer, Admission requirements, Academic requirements, Prerequisites, Minimum requirements
UK "Typical offer ABB" is for A-levels, not international equivalents

requirements.label: Location
cells: Campus, Location, Study location, Where you'll study, Delivery location, Venue
Surrey "Campus: Stag Hill"; UWS "Location: Lanarkshire, Paisley"

requirements.label: Delivery mode
cells: Delivery, Study mode, Attendance, Mode of study, On campus, Online, Blended
Excelsia "Delivery: On campus"

requirements.label: Course code
cells: CRICOS code, UCAS code, Course code, Programme code, DLI
Store each type separately

requirements.label: Entry year in title
cells: "Accounting and Finance — 2027 Entry" (Surrey)
Accounting and Finance BSc (Hons)

requirements.label: Marketing words
cells: "Accounting and Finance BSc (Hons) degree course 2027 entry"
Accounting and Finance BSc (Hons)

requirements.label: University name in title
cells: "BAcc Accounting | UWS | University of the West of Scotland"
BAcc (Hons) Accounting

requirements.label: Award missing
cells: "Accounting" with "Award: BAcc (Hons)" shown separately (UWS)
BAcc (Hons) Accounting

requirements.label: Name is just the domain
cells: "Excelsia.edu.au"
Take the name from the main page heading. Flag if none is found

requirements.label: Location or mode in name
cells: "MBA (Online)", "Nursing – Sydney campus"
Keep the name. Store mode and campus in their own fields

requirements.label: Multiple awards on one page
cells: "Aerospace Engineering BEng (Hons) or MEng"
Separate records: "Aerospace Engineering BEng (Hons)" and "Aerospace Engineering MEng"

requirements.label: Variant suffixes
cells: "with placement", "with foundation year", "Year 3 entry", "top-up"
Keep as part of the variant's name; each variant is its own record

requirements.label: Course code in name
cells: "ED45 Graduate Certificate in Christian Leadership"
Graduate Certificate in Christian Leadership (code in its own field)

requirements.label: Abbreviation only
cells: "MSc CS", "BBus"
Use the full name from the page heading

requirements.label: Odd characters
cells: HTML entities (&), double spaces, trailing dashes, "– Apply now"
Clean the text and trim

requirements.label: Wrong page captured
cells: News headline ("Celebrating our first PhD graduate…"), event or blog title
Not a course: skip it

requirements.label: Location
cells: A campus, city or place name (short, no sentence)
"The full amount is subject to…", "Apply now", "See fees"

requirements.label: Fee
cells: A number + currency (or currency symbol)
"Fees and funding", "TBC", "£" with no number, a UK/home fee

requirements.label: Duration
cells: A number + time unit (years, months, semesters, weeks)
"Full time", "Varies", a credit-point count with no unit

requirements.label: Intake
cells: Month, season or term name
"Apply by 30 June" (a deadline, not an intake), "Open days"

requirements.label: IELTS
cells: A score between 4.0 and 9.0
65 (a PTE or TOEFL score mixed in), "6.5 or equivalent" with no test name

requirements.label: Course name
cells: Passes the name rule in section 10
Domain names, news headlines

requirements.label: Several course options in one block
cells: Surrey: standard, with placement, with foundation year, each with its own duration
One record per option, each with its own duration and fee

requirements.label: Fees in a separate tab or section
cells: "Fees and funding" tab, loaded on click
Open the tab before reading. Never take a fee from the overview text

requirements.label: Asterisked fees
cells: "Overseas fees £24,600 *" with a footnote about placement years
Store the main fee. Read the footnote and store the condition

requirements.label: Placement or foundation year fee
cells: Reduced fee for the placement year
Store as a separate note, not the annual fee

requirements.label: Year-specific entry
cells: UWS "Lanarkshire: September (Yrs 2 & 3 only)"
Store intake per campus with the entry-year restriction

requirements.label: Fee in a table with several rows
cells: Year, home fee, overseas fee across columns
Match the column header "Overseas/International" and the right year row

requirements.label: Same label used twice
cells: "Duration" for full-time and part-time
Store full-time as the main value

requirements.label: Text from navigation or forms
cells: Dropdown course lists, enquiry forms, menus
Read only the main content area

requirements.label: Old or future year on page
cells: "2026 fees" and "2027 fees" side by side
Store the fee for the next available intake, with its year

requirements.label: Fee per year vs total on same page
cells: "$11,150 semester / $44,600 total" (Excelsia)
Store the total with basis "full course", and the semester rate

requirements.label: Sticky banners and pop-ups
cells: Cookie banners, "Open days" banners mixed into text
Ignore them when extracting

requirements.label: Stop and repair zero-progress bulk extraction
cells: Fix process rule. When a bulk re-extraction resolves 0 of N rows (as happened on Surrey: 70 attempted, 0 resolved), the agent must stop, inspect 3 sample pages, identify the missing label or pattern, update the provider rule, and re-run. Re-running the same broken rule is never a fix.
